name: coinscope-android-shell
description: Native Android wrapper for the Coinscope local coin scanner. Capacitor scaffold that bundles the scanner PWA into an APK that talks to a Mac-hosted FastAPI backend over Wi-Fi.

scripts.build:debug: npm run sync-www && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync-www && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
